name: Actions Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Actions Technology Co., Ltd., a fabless semiconductor company, engages in the research and development, and sale of audio SoC and integrated chips in China. It offers ICs for Bluetooth speaker, wireless transmitter, edge AL processor, home audio, smart watch, Bluetooth headset, wireless internet of Things, portable audio, and portable video. Actions Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Zhuhai, China.
